contact.basis: Sampled original coarse Copernicus surface elevation on the western garden approach.

sources.method: Original Copernicus GLO-30 surface elevations are interpolated in the model frame. The coarse city grid includes returns from overhead roofs and vegetation and is not shaved or replaced.
